title: 第010章 系统反吞噬第011章 外星修士降临
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家

识海之中，战斗还没有结束。
太玄仙尊的残魂被系统的光索缠绕拖入识海深处后，并没有立刻被吞噬。大乘境的残魂，即使只剩下万分之一的力量，也远超普通修士的想象。它在识海深处疯狂挣扎，每一次挣动都让张德华的识海剧烈震颤。
“小辈！你以为这点伎俩能困住本座？”太玄仙尊的声音在识海中回荡，带着十万年修为积累的威压，“本座纵横仙界的时候，你祖宗的祖宗还没出生！”
张德华的意识体站在识海边缘，双手抱胸，面无表情地看着那团正在挣扎的残魂。
“系统，还需要多久？”
“预计三分钟。”系统的声音依然平静，“大乘境残魂的复杂度超出预期，分解需要时间。”
“三分钟……”张德华点了点头，“我等你。”
识海深处，太玄仙尊的残魂突然爆发出一股恐怖的力量。它不再挣扎，而是开始主动吞噬张德华识海中的灵魂能量——它要反客为主，先吞噬张德华的灵魂，再控制他的身体。
“小辈！你以为只有你有吞噬能力？”太玄仙尊狂笑，“本座修炼的《噬魂大法》，专吞他人灵魂壮大自身！你的识海，就是本座最好的养料！”
残魂化作一张巨大的嘴，张开血盆大口，向张德华的意识体扑来。
张德华没有动。他只是抬了抬眼皮。
“你是不是搞错了什么？”
识海深处，系统的力量再次涌出。这一次，不是光索，而是一张铺天盖地的巨网。巨网由无数道光丝编织而成，每一根光丝都代表着华夏联盟五千年文明积累的智慧和力量——数学、物理、化学、生物、工程、军事、战略、哲学……所有人类文明的精华，在这一刻汇聚成一张天罗地网。
巨网罩住太玄仙尊的残魂，猛地收紧。
“这是什么？！”太玄仙尊的声音第一次出现了恐惧。他试图挣脱，但每挣断一根光丝，就有十根新的缠上来。那些光丝不是灵能，不是法力，不是他见过的任何一种力量。它们更像是……规则。宇宙最底层的规则，被他完全无法理解的方式具现化。
“这是华夏文明。”张德华说，“五千年文明积累的智慧。你活了十万年，很强。但华夏文明的底蕴，不是你能想象的。”
巨网继续收紧。太玄仙尊的残魂被压缩、压缩、再压缩，从一个人形变成一团光球，从光球变成一个光点，从光点变成虚无。
“不——！”
最后一声惨叫在识海中消散。

大乘境残魂，被系统彻底分解。
分解后的灵魂能量并没有消失，而是化作一股精纯的力量，从识海深处涌出，涌入张德华的意识体，再通过意识体流入他的丹田。
丹田之中，元婴猛地睁开双眼。
精纯的灵魂力量如潮水般涌入元婴，元婴的身高开始疯狂增长。九寸八分、十寸、十一寸、十二寸……每一寸的增长都伴随着法力量级的翻倍，元婴的身体越来越凝实，五官越来越清晰，周身的光晕越来越浓郁。
元婴八重巅峰的瓶颈，在灵魂力量的冲击下如同纸糊。
“轰——”
元婴九重，突破。
但灵魂力量仍然没有用完。它继续涌入元婴，推动元婴继续成长。
元婴九重初期、九重中期、九重后期、九重巅峰……
当灵魂力量终于耗尽时，张德华的修为已经达到了元婴九重巅峰。距离化神，只差半步。
“系统，修为评估。”
“宿主当前修为：元婴九重巅峰。肉身强度：堪比化神后期。法力总量：元婴九重巅峰标准值的五十倍。神识覆盖范围：三千里。综合战力评估——可与炼虚巅峰修士一战。”
元婴九重，可战炼虚巅峰。
张德华深吸一口气，缓缓睁开眼睛。
现实中，他的身体猛地一震，一股恐怖的气息从体内涌出，将周围的陆战队员震退了数步。他的双眼中有金光闪烁，那是元婴巅峰修士特有的异象——元婴圆满，神魂壮大到可以外放显形。
“首长！”陈铁军惊呼，“您的修为……”
“元婴巅峰。”张德华站起身，活动了一下筋骨，“太玄仙尊送的礼不小。连破两重，从元婴八重直接到九重巅峰。”

In the sea of consciousness, the battle is not over yet.
After Taixuan Immortal Lord's remnant soul was entangled by the system's light cord and dragged into the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, it was not swallowed immediately. Even if the remnant soul of the Mahayana realm has only one ten thousandth of its power, it is far beyond the imagination of ordinary monks. It struggled wildly in the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, and every movement made Zhang Dehua's sea of ​​consciousness tremble violently.
"Junior! Do you think this trick can trap me?" Taixuan Immortal Lord's voice echoed in the sea of consciousness, carrying the pressure accumulated from a hundred thousand years of cultivation. "When I was traversing the immortal world, your ancestors were not born yet!"
Zhang Dehua's conscious body stood at the edge of the sea of consciousness, with his hands folded across his chest, looking at the struggling remnant soul with an expressionless face.
"System, how long will it take?"
"Estimated three minutes." The voice of the system was still calm, "The complexity of the remnant soul of the Mahayana realm exceeds expectations, and it will take time to decompose."
"Three minutes..." Zhang Dehua nodded, "I'll wait for you."
Deep in the sea of consciousness, the remnant soul of Taixuan Immortal Lord suddenly burst out with a terrifying force. It no longer struggled, but began to actively devour the soul energy in Zhang Dehua's sea of ​​consciousness - it wanted to turn its back on the guest, first devour Zhang Dehua's soul, and then control his body.
"Junior! Do you think you are the only one with the ability to swallow?" Taixuan Immortal Lord laughed wildly, "The "Soul-Eating Technique" that I practice is specially designed to swallow other people's souls to strengthen myself! Your sea of consciousness is my best nourishment!"
The remnant soul turned into a huge mouth, opened its bloody mouth, and rushed towards Zhang Dehua's conscious body.
Zhang Dehua did not move. He just raised his eyelids.
"Did you make a mistake?"
Deep in the sea of consciousness, the power of the system surged out again. This time, it's not a light cable, but a huge overwhelming net. The giant web is woven from countless light filaments. Each light filament represents the wisdom and power accumulated by the five thousand years of civilization of the Chinese Alliance - mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, military, strategy, philosophy... The essence of all human civilizations converges into a dragnet at this moment.
The giant net covered the remnant soul of Taixuan Immortal Lord and tightened suddenly.
"What is this?!" Fear appeared in Taixuan Immortal Lord's voice for the first time. He tried to break free, but every time he broke a strand of light, ten new ones tangled up. Those strands of light were not spiritual energy, not mana, not any kind of power he had ever seen. They're more like... rules. The lowest rules of the universe were embodied in a way that he couldn't understand at all.
"This is Chinese civilization." Zhang Dehua said, "The wisdom accumulated by five thousand years of civilization. You have lived for one hundred thousand years and are very strong. But the foundation of Chinese civilization is beyond your imagination."
The giant net continues to tighten. The remnant soul of Taixuan Immortal Lord was compressed, compressed, and compressed again, from a human form to a ball of light, from the ball of light to a point of light, and from the point of light to nothingness.
"No-!"
The last scream dissipated in the sea of consciousness.
The remaining souls of the Mahayana realm were completely decomposed by the system.
The decomposed soul energy did not disappear, but turned into a pure force, pouring out from the depths of the sea of ​​consciousness, pouring into Zhang Dehua's conscious body, and then flowing into his Dantian through the conscious body.
In his dantian, Nascent Soul suddenly opened his eyes.
Pure soul power poured into Yuanying like a tide, and Yuanying's height began to grow crazily. Nine and eight inches, ten inches, eleven inches, twelve inches... Each inch of growth is accompanied by a doubling of the mana level. Yuanying's body becomes more and more solid, his facial features become clearer and clearer, and the halo around him becomes more and more intense.
The bottleneck of the eighth level of Nascent Soul is like paper under the impact of soul power.
"Boom——"
Ninth level of Nascent Soul, breakthrough.
But the soul power is still not used up. It continues to flow into the Nascent Soul, pushing the Nascent Soul to continue to grow.
The early stage of the ninth level of Nascent Soul, the middle stage of the ninth level, the late stage of the ninth level, the peak of the ninth level...
When the soul power was finally exhausted, Zhang Dehua's cultivation had reached the peak of the ninth level of Nascent Soul. It's only half a step away from becoming a god.
"System, cultivation evaluation. "
"The host's current cultivation level is: the peak of the ninth level of Nascent Soul. Physical strength: comparable to the late stage of divine transformation. The total amount of mana: fifty times the standard value of the ninth level of Nascent Soul. Divine consciousness coverage: three thousand miles. Comprehensive combat strength assessment - can fight with the monks at the peak of Xu Refining. "
The ninth level of Nascent Soul can compete with the peak of Xu Lian.
Zhang Dehua took a deep breath and slowly opened his eyes.
In reality, his body shook violently, and a terrifying aura surged out of his body, knocking the surrounding Marines back a few steps. There was a golden light shining in his eyes, which was a vision unique to the monks at the peak of the Yuanying - the Yuanying was perfect, and the soul was so strong that it could be revealed.
"Chief! "Chen Tiejun exclaimed, "Your cultivation level..."
“The peak of Nascent Soul. "Zhang Dehua stood up and stretched his muscles, "The gift from Taixuan Immortal is not small. Breaking through two levels in a row, going directly from the eighth level of Nascent Soul to the peak of the ninth level. "
